rows.text: The National Returning Officer's statement dated '19th January, 2026 (Monday)' says that 'today, on 19th January 2026 (Monday), Nomination Process was completed between 2 PM to 4 PM' and that 'In all, 37 sets of Nomination Papers were received in favour of Shri Nitin Nabin for the post of National President'.

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The same statement says 'On scrutiny, all sets of Nomination Papers were found to be duly-filled up in the required format and were valid'.

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The same statement says 'after the period of withdrawal, in my capacity of National Returning Officer, Sangathan Parv, Bharatiya Janata Party, I hereby announce that only 1 name, that of Shri Nitin Nabin, has been proposed for the post of National President of Bharatiya Janata Party'.
